code:
esphome:
  name: esp32-ble
  friendly_name: ESP32 BLE Proxy 24.220

esp32:
  board: esp32dev
  framework:
    type: esp-idf

# Enable logging
logger:
  level: INFO
  
# Enable Home Assistant API
api:
  encryption:
    key: 3hfRUNfy8QYMZSsAPtCTBATHRTOye0h3nsED3+WDvsw=

ota:
  platform: esphome
  password: "12345678"

wifi:
  ssid: 2GHz_sucks
  password: wifi2fast4me
  manual_ip:
    static_ip: 192.168.24.220
    gateway: 192.168.24.1
    subnet: 255.255.255.0
  
  # Enable fallback hotspot (captive portal) in case wifi connection fails
  ap:
    ssid: "Ble-Sensor-Hub Fallback Hotspot"
    password: "gsGCxoYbCDWb"
    
web_server:
  port: 80

esp32_ble_tracker:
  #scan_interval: 300s

# --- БЛОК ПОДКЛЮЧЕНИЯ К OBD-МОДУЛЮ ---
ble_client:
  - mac_address: "AA:BB:CC:11:22:33"
    id: obd_car_client

elm327_ble:
  ble_client_id: obd_car_client
  id: my_car_elm
  
# Настройка сенсоров
sensor:
  # Датчик Xiaomi №1
  - platform: atc_mithermometer
    mac_address: "A4:C1:38:DE:AE:43"
    temperature:
      name: "ATC Temperature"
    humidity:
      name: "ATC Humidity"
    battery_level:
      name: "ATC Battery Level"
    battery_voltage:
      name: "ATC Battery Voltage"
    signal_strength:
      name: "ATC Signal"
      
  # Датчик Xiaomi №2
  - platform: atc_mithermometer
    mac_address: "A4:C1:38:C0:46:F0"
    temperature:
      name: "ATC Temperature 2"
    humidity:
      name: "ATC Humidity 2"
    battery_level:
      name: "ATC Battery Level 2"
    battery_voltage:
      name: "ATC Battery Voltage 2"
    signal_strength:
      name: "ATC Signal 2"

  # --- ДАТЧИКИ АВТОМОБИЛЯ GREAT WALL HOVER H3 ---
  - platform: elm327_ble
    elm327_ble_id: my_car_elm
    
    # 1. Обороты двигателя (об/мин)
    rpm:
      name: "Ховер: Обороты двигателя"
      icon: "mdi:engine"
      accuracy_decimals: 0
      
    # 2. Температура антифриза (°C)
    engine_coolant_temperature:
      name: "Ховер: Температура антифриза"
      icon: "mdi:thermometer-coolant"
      accuracy_decimals: 0
      
    # 3. Бортовое напряжение (В)
    battery_voltage:
      name: "Ховер: Напряжение сети"
      icon: "mdi:car-battery"
      accuracy_decimals: 1

    # 4. Скорость автомобиля (км/ч)
    speed:
      name: "Ховер: Скорость"
      icon: "mdi:speedometer"
      accuracy_decimals: 0

    # 5. Положение дроссельной заслонки (%)
    throttle_position:
      name: "Ховер: Дроссельная заслонка"
      icon: "mdi:throttle"
      accuracy_decimals: 0

    # 6. Расход воздуха через MAF-сенсор
    mass_air_flow:
      name: "Ховер: Расход воздуха MAF"
      icon: "mdi:air-filter"
      accuracy_decimals: 1
